card.name: Gram units after a number
card.fires_on: The unit word (grams, g, gm, or G for gauge) right after a number or number range in dose amounts. Also fires on 'products' after 'agents or' or 'receiving'.

modes.label: Gram units after number
modes.description: The unit grams/g/gm (or gauge G) directly after a number, often the end of a range.
modes.example: 5 grams to 15<< grams>> orally, twice daily based on body weight

modes.label: Products after receiving
modes.description: The word 'products' naming drug-containing items, after 'receiving' or 'agents or'.
